purpose: Small canonical derivatives for effect cards; full PNGs remain in the animations.

assets.method: Proportional downscale of the entire RGBA canvas; no recoloring, crop, repaint or change to the runtime effect.
assets.exception: Existing shared physical ice, trumpet or natural flame; theme-neutral by design.
assets.review: Compared all 43 proportional RGBA derivatives with canonical originals in the effect-card-derivatives-v1.png contact sheet, large and 28 px views. Silhouette, palette, transparent edges and optical proportions are preserved. Runtime animations retain the originals; only card previews use these smaller variants.
